highlights.title: The effort stays in one piece
highlights.text: On a phone, Details' Ran on row used to split "· medium effort" across two lines. Now it moves to the next line whole.

highlights.title: Ran on reads cleanly on a phone
highlights.text: Open Details under a reply on a narrow screen: the model, where it ran and the effort stay readable, with no word left hanging.

fixes: Go to the approval's flash no longer makes the approval card jump.
Stop on a chat now also stops the lead's follow-up to a hand-off that was just reporting back.
A second press on Go to the approval flashes the card again.
